mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically signals reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL 12-month change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a dovish monetary policy combined with a strong labor market, which typically boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dovish policy and strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime, a federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates restrictive policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
